info.title: Trellis Public API v1
info.description: Public, versioned REST contracts for workspace-scoped Trellis tasks and properties. Authenticate with an existing workspace API key.

tags.name: tasks
tags.description: Trellis task contracts generated from Hono/Zod schemas.

tags.name: properties
tags.description: Trellis property contracts generated from Hono/Zod schemas.

WorkspaceApiKey.description: Workspace-scoped Trellis API key created from Settings > Developer. The requested `workspaceId` must match the key workspace.

manualConfig.description: Guest manual configuration stored for this property.

customFields.description: Workspace-specific property fields configured in Trellis.

aiProvenance.description: AI provenance metadata attached to tasks created or enriched by agents.

customFields.description: Workspace-specific task fields configured in Trellis.

totalCost.description: Daily total when all costed work orders use one currency; null for mixed currency.

totalCostCurrency.description: The daily total currency, MIXED for multiple currencies, or null when no cost exists.

costTotalsByCurrency.description: Daily task cost totals grouped by currency.

get.description: Returns one non-deleted Trellis property by id within the authenticated workspace.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a Trellis property in the authenticated workspace.

patch.description: Updates a Trellis property in the authenticated workspace.
